articles.제목: IAEA reviews Jordan's nuclear regulatory framework
articles.원문 요약: Jordan has a "well-established regulatory framework for nuclear and radiation safety", an International Atomic Energy Agency mission has said, while also suggesting further enhancements in line with international safety standards.

AtkinsRéalis producing study for six-unit Candu plant in Turkey
articles.원문 요약: AtkinsRéalis's Candu Energy Inc and state-owned Türkiye Nükleer Enerji Anonim Şirketi have signed a memorandum of agreement which includes a feasibility study for a potential 4.5 GW plant featuring up to six Candu reactors.

articles.제목: First steam generator installed at Lufeng unit 1
articles.원문 요약: The first of two steam generators has been installed at unit 1 of the Lufeng nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province, China Nuclear Industry 23 Construction Company Limited has announced.
The power output of the fourth unit at Slovakia's Mochovce Nuclear Power Plant has been increased to 35% as the new reactor continues its commissioning process.

articles.제목: Bids invited for construction of UK prototype fusion plant
articles.원문 요약: UK Fusion Energy is seeking tenders for five engineering contracts worth up to GBP115 million (USD152 million) covering the design, integration, testing and control of key systems needed to operate the planned STEP fusion power plant.
